'''2009 2K Event Day 1 John Veasey DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ISB done sorta kinda right
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
